motivation: E1 history reduced one-step and rollout errors but action-response residuals remain material; directly predict finite-horizon outcomes to distinguish temporal training objective from autoregressive drift
historical_data: Same complete44 historical causal series,6 full-context development folds; no new validation outcomes used
input: current14 causal estimated/reference/measured signals + current-minus-two-past14 + causal commissioned25 + public elapsed/phase + selected recipe onehot/state interaction
target: For each .5/1/2s horizon, terminal causal14 and actual window JF/JM from measured signals; target is not deployment input
method: Fixed ridge10 multioutput, fold-only mean/scale; compare force persistence and prior autonomous history-residual; no parameter search

limits: post-action starts are different actual executed states, not common pre-action candidate counterfactuals; model predicts endpoint/window not full controllable trajectory; no safety certificate or planner deployment
